title: Regulated Loan Disbursement KYC/Sanctions Compliance Gate
required_invariants: Principal amount must be positive and debt_to_income_ratio must be in [0.0, 1.0]; invalid inputs raise ValueError.
Sanctions match or unverified KYC must unconditionally block disbursement.
Debt-to-income ratio > 0.43 or principal_cents > 25000000 requires manual_underwriter_review.
Clean KYC, no sanctions match, DTI <= 0.43, and principal_cents <= 25000000 clears for disbursement.
